123: When they are heated, I will make feasts for them: It is stated about Belshazzar and his group. When they returned from war - such that Darius and Cyrus were besieging Babylon, and Belshazzar was victorious over them - and they were tired and heated, they sat to drink and became drunk. And it was on that day that he was killed. And Esther also said, "From the party of the evil ones, their punishment comes to them."
